final_topology.title: Secure Government Data Center
final_topology.description: A secure government data center with a DMZ, load-balanced web servers, and segmented production, staging, and management zones.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a screened DMZ with a WAF and load-balanced web servers. The core application and database servers are in a production zone, while internal firewalls segment the staging and management networks. Redundant connectivity, content filtering, and SIEM integration are provided.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management' zone with an 'Asset Management System' node (n28) and a 'Asset Inventory System' node (n_new1). These nodes are connected to various other nodes, indicating management and inventory capabilities.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' zone (z9) with a 'Data Flow Documentation System' node (n29). This node is connected to various other nodes, indicating data flow documentation capabilities.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (DMZ, Production, Staging, Management) with internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) segmenting these zones, indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) in the Production, Staging, and Management zones, indicating the presence of firewalls on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n21) in the DMZ zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13), indicating the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Server (n22) and a Centralized AAA Server (n26) in the Management zone, which are connected to the edge router (n13) and the VPN gateway (n27), indicating the requirement for MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Content Filter (n16) in the Content Filtering zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13) and the DR router (n15), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Content Filter (n16) in the Content Filtering zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13) and the DR router (n15), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (DMZ, Production, Staging, Management) with internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) and switches (n17, n18, n19, n20) segmenting and managing network traffic, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Secure Management zone (z10) with a Secure Management System (n30) that manages various network devices, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Centralized AAA Server (n26) in the Management zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13) and the VPN gateway (n27), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN Gateway (n27) in the DMZ zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13) and the Centralized AAA Server (n26), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n24) in the DMZ zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13) and the SIEM (n14), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) in the Production, Staging, and Management zones, which segment and filter traffic between these zones.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n25) in the DMZ zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13), indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n14) in the DMZ zone, which is connected to the edge router (n13) and the NIDS (n24), indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for Production (z2), Staging (z3), and Management (z4), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing zone (z7) with a Penetration Testing Service (n31) that is connected to various nodes in the DMZ, Production, Staging, and Management zones, indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.
